scope: New start distribution and corrected current-policy entropy; fresh pure MAPPO weights
authorization: User requested different robot initial positions and authorized continuing formal pure-RL training; local audit 2026-09-30
transition_unit: one environment control step, not individual robot samples
task: Nominal MCA anatomy and clot sites; seeded starts on distinct navigable branches; random passive tracers

comparability: Separate protocol: do not pool EXP23 fixed-start results or reuse its divergent weights
